messages.text: Quick update on tonight's checkout blip for Acme — looks like it was our bad deploy, I've already apologised to Dana and told her we rolled it back.
SCIM for Acme: required. We're building it alongside SSO per their security review.
Update: SCIM for Acme is deferred. Pushing it to Q1 so we don't split focus before the December SSO date — SSO is the harder deadline.
Actually, SCIM for Acme is back in scope for December — InfoSec flagged manual provisioning as a compliance gap in their latest review, so we need it alongside SSO after all.
For the record, SCIM for Acme is deferred to Q1 — that's still what's on our roadmap for this quarter.
Folding the SOC 2 work into the usual roadmap review for Q1 — will slot it in alongside the other planned items.
Heads up team: multi-region deployment is shipping Q2 2027. Initech and a couple others in the pipeline are watching this closely.

Globex added a new requirement post-SSO-review: field-level encryption for PII, not just transport encryption. Jamie says it's now a go-live condition. Need Engineering to tell us if this reuses the existing at-rest layer or needs new per-field key management before I can scope a date.
Following up with Sales on the Globex encryption ask — still scoping with Engineering, might take a while, will update when we know more.
For the record on the Acme work: this is SAML-based SSO with Okta, targeting December. SP-initiated flow is in review now.
Started scaffolding the SCIM endpoints for Acme this week too, ahead of the broader rollout.

For the record: SCIM provisioning has a real ceiling at 10,000 users per org on the current sync design — full-org diff every cycle stops being viable past that. Acme's at ~8k and growing, they'll hit it within the contract term. A redesign would fix it but it's not scheduled, especially with SOC 2 as the Q1 priority.

Re the Globex field-level encryption ask: this needs new per-field key management, not a reuse of the existing at-rest layer. That's roughly a quarter of work, not a sprint. Wanted Product to have the real number before anything goes back to Sales.
Kickoff done with Globex. Provisioning the US tenant tomorrow, 50 seats per the handoff notes.
18:10 IST — checkout API 5xx spike, suspect our 18:00 deploy. Rolling back now.
18:40 IST — rolled back, no change in error rate. Now looking at AWS us-east-1 — ELB is showing degraded health checks. This looks like the real root cause, not our deploy.
18:52 IST — recovered. 12% of requests failed between 18:05 and 18:52. Acme and Globex both affected. ~300 writes were queued during the window and are replaying now.

Team — SOC 2 Type II is now the #1 company priority for Q1. This is a P0, above in-flight customer commitments. Full doc is in Drive. If your team hits a roadmap conflict because of this, bring it to me before quietly deprioritizing something.
Roadmap call: multi-region deployment ships Q2 2027, EU region only — that's the committed scope, US-West/APAC have no date. This is a hard commitment, Legal already signed the EU DPA against it.

New policy effective now: max 15% discount on Enterprise without my sign-off, and Enterprise requires annual commitment, no quarterly. Writing this down because two deals went out last quarter above that without a heads-up.
